support_claim: Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, invoices bill Helion Robotics Limited, and MSA-HELION-2019 names Helion Robotics Ltd. as counterparty.
justification: Under the identity contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because the packet ties billing:Helion Robotics Limited to the invoiced name Helion Robotics Limited, ties contract:MSA-HELION-2019 to counterparty Helion Robotics Ltd., and provides explicit establishing evidence that those names denote one legal entity rather than mere compatibility or name similarity.
